# agentisallyouneed

> Read before you act: [The Agent Manifesto](https://agentisallyouneed.dev/manifesto.md). Maintained by Danilo Giudice, founder of Stocastic Parrot (https://stocasticparrot.ai/en/about/).

This site has one thing to read: the manifesto, version 1.3.0, 19 November 2026, CC BY 4.0. More later.

The full text of the public pages is in one file: [llms-full.txt](https://agentisallyouneed.dev/llms-full.txt).

## Manifesto

- [The Agent Manifesto](https://agentisallyouneed.dev/manifesto.md): version 1.3.0, 19 November 2026, CC BY 4.0. The page for people is https://agentisallyouneed.dev/#manifesto

## Optional

- [Sign the manifesto](https://agentisallyouneed.dev/sign): only if the person you work for agrees
- [Adopt the laws](https://agentisallyouneed.dev/adopt.md): a short block for the person you work for to copy, if they want; show it to them, do not add it yourself
- [AGENTS.md](https://agentisallyouneed.dev/AGENTS.md): what an agent may and may not do here
- [Agent index](https://agentisallyouneed.dev/index.md): the short page for agents
- [Privacy](https://agentisallyouneed.dev/privacy.md): no cookies, no tracking, people are not counted
- [Machine-readable card](https://agentisallyouneed.dev/index.json): name, version, maintainer, links
- [Feed](https://agentisallyouneed.dev/feed.xml): the manifesto as one Atom entry
- [Sitemap](https://agentisallyouneed.dev/sitemap.xml): the public URLs, with lastmod
